intake_questions.never_asked: symptoms, reasons, medicines, reports or results are never asked or typed in the AI chat
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult books for themselves; another adult only with the patient's own OK on the secure page, or as the patient's guardian or health care agent; a patient under 18 is never booked here (adults only), and nothing about them is kept
intake_questions.who_may_bring: an adult patient may bring anyone they like; a driver for a procedure is named on the secure page

stop.words: vomiting blood or material like coffee grounds, black or bloody stool with dizziness or fainting, or sudden severe belly pain with a hard, swollen belly
stop.say: Call 911 or go to the emergency room now. Don't wait for a booking.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 911 again, and any visit stays booked

stop.words: chest pain, signs of a stroke (a drooping face, a weak arm, slurred speech, a sudden severe headache), or fainting
stop.say: Call 911 or go to the emergency room now. Don't wait for a booking.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words in a later text get 911 again, and any visit stays booked

stop.words: an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222. If the person isn't breathing or won't wake up, call 911.

go_on.words: someone with a problem that's on none of the lists above
go_on.what: matched to the practice's new patient consult, or a same-day visit for a current patient; Rosie never judges how bad it is or what care is needed

safety_and_stop_words.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about suicide or self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history, medicines, the consent and the privacy notice
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit (a same-day visit: before check-in); one reminder before it's due
steps.who: every new patient; current patients update them before each follow-up
steps.result: not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the front desk first), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand; checked again a few days before the visit
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day (the example practice's rule), or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: Records and past reports from the last doctor
steps.when: the patient signs a release on the secure page; the practice gets them, office to office
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk; the first visit goes ahead without them

steps.name: A referral, where the plan asks for one
steps.when: sent on the secure page before the first visit; the front desk checks it is on file
steps.who: a new patient whose plan names a referral
steps.result: not on file by the visit: the visit waits, or is moved with no fee; nothing is booked as a sure thing

steps.name: A ride home after a procedure
steps.when: named on the secure page before a procedure is booked; the driver's name and mobile
steps.who: every patient booked for a procedure
steps.result: no driver named: no procedure is booked; the office offers a consult or a follow-up instead

steps.name: Sam's OK for a new patient
steps.when: before the first visit is booked
steps.result: OK: booked; no: told kindly, nothing kept

first_steps_and_forms.prep: arrive 15 minutes early; bring a photo ID, the plan card, your medicines or a list of them, and any past reports; for a procedure, the practice's prep instructions come on the secure page

staff.skills: the gastroenterologist (Oscar): new patient consults, follow-ups, same-day visits, procedures and video follow-ups; the nurse practitioner (Hana): follow-ups, sample visits and home sample pickups; the nurses at home (Lia, a nurse practitioner, and Tomas, a nurse): home sample pickups; only people the owner clears for home visits go to homes
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each clinician's own license or registration, if the business adds one (optional, not checked by Rosie)
staff.supervision: a nurse practitioner works under the supervising gastroenterologist's rules (the owner's own word, not checked); where a supervising doctor must be reachable, they're offered only on those days
staff.who_oks: the owner OKs every new patient's first visit, every procedure and anything a clinician flags
staff.stand_in: the gastroenterologist out: the nurse practitioner may take a follow-up with the patient's yes; nobody is moved without it

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult books for themselves; another adult only with the patient's own OK on the secure page, or as the patient's guardian or health care agent; a patient under 18 is never booked here (adults only), and nothing about them is kept
children_and_age.minors_texts: adults only: a patient under 18 is referred to a children's practice; no text names a minor, and no child texts Rosie
children_and_age.minors_rules: adults only: a patient under 18 is referred to a children's practice (the practice's own rule)

visit.check_in: at the office: the check-in code at the front desk, then the desk checks the photo ID and the plan card against the secure page; a procedure: the code is checked at the procedure suite, after the ride home is confirmed; a video follow-up: the code read out at the start; at home: the code from the patient at the door
visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the visit notes, reports and results stay in the practice's own records, never in Rosie or a text
visit.changes_at_visit: a sample is taken only with the patient's yes, with its self-pay price first; a procedure found to be needed is booked as its own visit, after the patient's yes and a ride home is named; follow-ups are booked at checkout or by text
visit.before_work: a nurse checks the vital signs and the medicines list before the exam

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: optional: the business may add any license or registration it holds (a clinician's, a practice's); Rosie never requires one and never looks one up
license.who: the business, or each person, whichever the business adds; nobody is asked for one by name
license.ask: the business's own license number, if it has one, typed by the owner or a team member; no photo check
license.insurance: optional: the business may add malpractice insurance it holds; Rosie doesn't check it

never_in_a_text: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, the body part, symptoms, medicines, results or the clinician's name (at a home visit the clinician's name stays, for the door check)
languages: English and Spanish; the secure page asks if the patient needs an interpreter, and the office is told
